notices.short_title: SLT-26: Cleaning and Repairs of Two Silver Lake Tanks
notices.description: This Contract is to provide all necessary labor, materials, tools, and equipment for cleaning of two underground water storage tanks. Work including but not limited to sediment removal, cleaning, waste disposal, disinfection, and replacement of waterproofing membrane of two underground drinking water storage tanks located in Staten Island.
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded DiFazio Industries LLC a $4.1 million contract, chosen through competitive sealed bids, to clean and repair two underground drinking water storage tanks at Silver Lake in Staten Island.

notices.short_title: PEAK Drop In Centers Program NAE with CASES
notices.vendor_name: Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services
notices.description: PEAK (Pathways to Excellence, Achievement and Knowledge) is an intensive, education-focused Alternative to Placement (ATP) program for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. The program combines educational enrichment, behavioral and therapeutic supports, and ongoing probation supervision to improve academic and behavioral outcomes and help youth remain safely in the community rather than enter residential placement.
notices.plain: The Department of Probation awarded the Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services a $989,808 negotiated contract to run the PEAK Drop In Centers program, an education-focused alternative to placement for youth in the juvenile justice system.

notices.description:
Corrected Notice

Pursuant to Section 3-04(b)(2)(iii) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, the New York City Department of Probation (DOP) intends to extend its existing contract with Center for Employment Opportunities, Inc. (CEO) through a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) for the continued provision of Neighborhood Employment Services.

Under this agreement, CEO will provide DOP clients and other justice-involved young adults with job readiness services, contractor-supervised transitional work opportunities at New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) locations, and subsequent job placement and retention services.

DOP has determined that a negotiated acquisition extension is necessary to address a compelling need for the continued provision of these essential employment services without interruption. The extension will allow DOP to maintain services with the existing provider while addressing its longer-term contracting needs. The proposed extension period represents the minimum time necessary to maintain service continuity.

The proposed extension term is March 1, 2025, through February …
notices.plain: The Department of Probation intends to extend its contract with Center for Employment Opportunities, Inc. without competitive bidding, to continue job readiness, transitional work and job placement services for justice-involved young adults at NYCHA locations.

notices.short_title: Capacity Building MWBE Moving Volunteers to Paid Staff
notices.description: The Department of Youth & Community Development (DYCD) is seeking an appropriately qualified vendor to provide training and support on identifying staffing needs; developing best practices in volunteer engagement, hiring and retention; managing payroll, employee rights and relations; and establishing systems for performance management, professional development, staff credentialing, and career pathways.
notices.plain: The Department of Youth and Community Development awarded L White Consulting LLC a $440,751 renewal contract to train and support community groups in moving volunteers into paid staff roles, covering hiring, payroll, performance management and career pathways.
